concept_attempts.feedback: Selected against own catalogue/detail and all sixteen correctly composited directional heads. Preserves broad asymmetric wedge/spade head tapering into TWO parallel rectangular prongs, real triangular support aperture, sloping grey-blue base, TWO side brass reservoirs/dark caps, TWO front ochre points, dark lower service slot and ONE low red marking. Source governs final rail length and proportions; the concept may slightly elongate prongs. Fine bearings, caps, recess depths and hidden geometry remain interpretation. No generic Terran dome or prior three circular emitters transferred.

glb_feedback.finding: Actual source/concept/independent GLB whole/front/rear/support board inspected. Source component counts, aperture, fork gap and65pose supports pass. Head/support appear too pale and matte compared with own grey-blue source and steel concept; soften key edges and use darker used steel PBR. Initial heading1 foreshortens the fork; choose heading5 for source-like comparison renders without changing the controller or geometry registration.
limitations: Camera/preview heading is presentation only, not calibrated legacy heading-index recovery.

glb_feedback.finding: Inspected final own-source/selected-concept/independent GLB whole/front/rear/fork-support board, final native hero and reservoir/front-fitting detail. Darker used steel and softened head/support edges improve the grey-blue source/concept match. Heading5 presentation reveals the source-like fork inclination without changing the controller. Broad asymmetric head, two rectangular prongs with a real gap, actual triangular support aperture, two fixed brass reservoirs/caps, two opaque front points, narrow slot and low red mark retain source identity. Actual native/independent GLB65pose checks pass:1692triangles/16closedpositivebatches/5materials/7maps; fourteen attachment contacts at every sample, stationary base, no unintended moving/fixed intersections, triangular opening/solid rays, distinct rails/gap rays, actual blind slot/backing, slope/chips, finite UVs, decoded pixels and retained controller/motion parity. Surface error5.372689884097781e-7; matrix error4.76837158203125e-7. No significant further source/concept discrepancy identified requiring another model pass.
limitations: Hidden bearing/cap/recess construction, rail inclination and cell-relative dimensions are authored. Heading5 and source-like camera are presentation, not calibrated legacy index recovery.
Own16directional heads establish heading movement, not autonomous scan, firing/recoil or light phases. Opaque front points are fittings, not recovered timed lamps.
65pose checks are sampled validation, not continuous-sweep proof. Client heading registration, weapon socket, scale/state/shader and Android performance remain separate.
Agent visual acceptance does not establish final user artistic approval; generic Terran PB17/ST19 anatomy is functional context only.
